name: Karnawati Innovation Limited
about: Karnawati Innovation Limited engages in the production and sale of mineral water and PET bottles in India. The company is also involved in cultivation, farming, and production of crops; goldsmiths and silver smiths; and plastic recycling. Its products are used for bottling liquor and products with gaseous contents. The company was formerly known as Bisil Plast Limited and changed its name to Karnawati Innovation Limited in October 2025. Karnawati Innovation Limited was incorporated in 1986 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.
